description: Licensed Sewer and Water Contractors is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. The following is a list of contractors licensed by the City Contractors that perform work on services, or install services that connect to the City sewer or water systems must be licensed by the City. Contact 311 for more information on how to become a licensed sewer and water contractor. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Water and Waste. Its tags are sewer, contactor, water. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
